meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩记忆文件为穴居人格式以节省输入令牌
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用自然语言文件记录信息并想减少AI输入成本
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into caveman format to save input tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use natural language files for notes and want to reduce AI input costs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将你的记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md）压缩成“穴居人”风格，去掉冗余词语，保留代码、链接和结构，从而节省输入 token。原文件会被备份为 .original.md。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 说“compress memory file”或输入命令 /caveman-compress <文件路径> 时触发。

say.note: Claude 会询问要压缩哪个文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can compress your memory files (e.g., CLAUDE.md) into caveman style, removing filler words while preserving code, URLs, and structure, saving input tokens. Original file is backed up as .original.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "compress memory file" or use the command /caveman-compress <filepath>.

say_en.note: Claude will ask which file to compress.
